sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Accidental Witness is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: "Next to the dorms, there's a sedan with a threatening message left on it. It seems one of the residents had a serious debt. But this Kozlov was probably not the only debtor in the industrial zone. Perhaps he was being hunted for a reason?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Locate the white scribbled-on car in the courtyard of the dormitories on Customs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Figure out where Kozlov lived
- Read the note on Kozlov's door
- Find out what Kozlov was involved in
  - (Optional) Access Kozlov's room
  - (Optional) Figure out where to get Kozlov's key
  - (Optional) Investigate Kozlov's room
- Ask the traders about Anastasia
- Access Skier's accomplice's apartment
  - (Optional) Find the key to the apartment
- Learn more about Skier's accomplice
  - (Optional) Investigate the apartment
- Read the documents in Skier's accomplice's apartment
- Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov
- Report to Skier
- Talk to Ragman
- Locate Anastasia's apartment
- Learn more about Anastasia
- Investigate the entrance of Anastasia's building
- Locate courier Pasha
- Search the ambush spot
- Talk to Skier
- Locate Reshala's stash
  - (Optional) Locate and neutralize Reshala
  - (Optional) Obtain the key to Reshala's stash
- Investigate Reshala's bunkhouse
  - (Optional) Obtain Reshala's work notes
  - (Optional) Obtain courier Pasha's belongings
- Locate Kozlov's hideout
- Locate and obtain Kozlov's evidence

sections.heading: Figure out where Kozlov lived/Read the note on Kozlov's door
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Note for Kozlov | 1 | Required | Yes |
Kozlov lived in dorm room 110 on the first floor of the two-story dorms on Customs. The note to pick up and read can be found below the room number.

sections.heading: Find out what Kozlov was involved in
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Dorm room 110 key | 1 | Required | N/A |
| Letter from Kozlov's room | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Note from the repair shop | 1 | Optional | Yes |
To fulfill this objective, you first have to enter Kozlov's room with a Dorm room 110 key, then pick up and read the letter located on the nightstand.

The optional Note from the repair shop on the wall in the kitchen next to room 110.

sections.heading: Ask the traders about Anastasia
sections.text: Visit Skier in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about Anastasia.

sections.heading: Access Skier's accomplice's apartment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Zmeisky 3 apartment key | 1 | Required | N/A |
The wanted apartment is located on the first floor of the Zmeisky 3 building on Streets of Tarkov. The entrance is on the backyard side. A Zmeisky 3 apartment key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Learn more about Skier's accomplice/Read the documents in Skier's accomplice's apartment
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| FSB report | FSB report | 1 | Required | Yes |
| The Ninth Circle Issue 14 | The Ninth Circle Issue #14 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| The Ninth Circle Issue 19 | The Ninth Circle Issue #19 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Tarkov Herald summary | Tarkov Herald summary | 1 | Required | Yes |
Inside the apartment are 4 items to pick up and read. There are multiple spawns for them.

sections.heading: Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: Extract from Streets of Tarkov with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status.

sections.heading: Report to Skier
sections.text: Visit Skier in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Talk to Ragman
sections.text: Visit Ragman in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Locate Anastasia's apartment
sections.text: The wanted apartment is located on the second floor of the Chekannaya 13 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Learn more about Anastasia/Investigate the entrance of Anastasia's building
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Letter from the mailbox | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Tarkov Herald newspaper with article by A. Mikhailova | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill this objective, you first have to go back down the stairs, then pick up and read the letter and the newspaper located in the mailbox.

sections.heading: Locate courier Pasha/Search the ambush spot
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Unsealed envelope | 1 | Required | Yes |
The spot where Pasha was ambushed is located next to the two-story dorms on Customs. The note to pick up and read can be found next to the bicycle.

sections.heading: Report to Skier
sections.text: Visit Skier in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Locate and investigate Reshala's stash
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Reshala's bunkhouse key | 1 | Required | N/A |
| Note with an address | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Note with a warning | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Letter from Reshala's bunkhouse | 1 | Required | Yes |
Reshala's stash is a bunkhouse on Customs. In the bunkhouse are 3 notes to pick up and read. A Reshala's bunkhouse key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Locate Kozlov's hideout and obtain his evidence
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Audio tape with incriminating evidence | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Newspaper clipping with a photo of Anastasia | 1 | Optional | Yes |
Kozlov's hideout is house no. 3 in the eastern part of the west village on Shoreline. The evidence in the form of an audio tape to pick up and listen can be found in the flower bed next to the entrance.

The optional Newspaper clipping with a photo of Anastasia inside the house on the floor.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +64,000 EXP
- Unlocks achievement Pay Your Debt
